scope: Malaysia medical discovery — University of Malaya Faculty of Medicine

institution.canonicalName: University of Malaya Faculty of Medicine
institution.programme: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)

verifiedFacts.claim: UM's Faculty of Medicine describes UMMP as a five-year professional undergraduate MBBS with clinical experience, research opportunities and elective placements.
UM accepts international undergraduate applications for 2026/27 and specifies a 9 June 2026 deadline for MBBS.
UM's international MBBS requirements document requires a recognised secondary qualification, specified English evidence, a recognised admission test and a satisfactory interview.

The Malaysian Qualifications Register records UM's full-time conventional MBBS as MQF Level 6, five years, with Malaysian Medical Council as professional body, accredited 24 February 2023 to 23 February 2028.
UM's international-fee schedule for academic session 2025/26 lists MBBS tuition of RM 673,200.

holdReasons: The only located international MBBS fee schedule is for 2025/26, while the official admissions page is already running the 2026/27 cycle. It is outside the active-cycle fee freshness window and cannot be published as current tuition.

The international requirement document is labelled 2020/21 in its source metadata. It supports the historic route but cannot by itself establish all current programme-specific eligibility requirements.
No current 2026/27 fee document with mandatory charges, instalments or payment conditions was located.
nextAction: Recheck UM Student Financial Centre once its 2026/27 international undergraduate fee schedule is published, then confirm current MBBS entry requirements with the Faculty before packaging.
